1. **Discovery & Translational Science**

* **[Optogenetics pioneers honored with 2026 Nobel Prize](https://www.statnews.com/2026/10/05/2026-nobel-prize-winning-optogenetics-research-explained/)** — *STAT*
  * The Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine was awarded to Peter Hegemann, Georg Nagel, and Karl Deisseroth for developing optogenetics, a foundational technique for modulating neuronal activity with light.
  * Hegemann and Nagel discovered channelrhodopsin, a light-sensing protein in algae, while Deisseroth engineered its application as an on/off molecular switch in mammalian nerve cells.

* **[Plasma eMTBR-tau outscores p-tau217 as Alzheimer's pathology biomarker](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.29.26363951)** — *bioRxiv/medRxiv/PubMed*
  * A blood-based immunoassay for an endogenously cleaved eMTBR-tau fragment was shown to strongly reflect the burden and anatomical progression of neurofibrillary tangles in autopsy-diagnosed Alzheimer's disease neuropathologic change (ADNC).
  * Plasma eMTBR-tau classified Braak staging and ADNC status with high accuracy (AUC = 0.91–0.95), maintaining superior diagnostic sensitivity and specificity over p-tau217 even when blood was collected up to a decade prior to death.

* **[AlphaFISH platform links spatial host-microbiome to colorectal cancer recurrence](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.29.26363734)** — *bioRxiv/medRxiv/PubMed*
  * The spatial profiling technology AlphaFISH integrated high-throughput transcriptomics and spatial microbiome mapping at subcellular resolution across 149 colorectal biopsies.
  * Supported by a 4.27-million-cell single-cell RNA-seq reference atlas, deep learning analysis of host-microbe spatial co-localization successfully predicted post-resection tumor recurrence.

* **[Preclinical biomarkers identify tarlatamab-associated toxicity risk](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.10.02.26364624)** — *bioRxiv/medRxiv/PubMed*
  * A multi-institutional retrospective cohort analysis of 115 extensive-stage small cell lung cancer (ES-SCLC) patients receiving the bispecific T-cell engager tarlatamab characterized real-world safety events.
  * Observed rates of adverse events were 46% for cytokine release syndrome (CRS), 28% for immune effector cell-associated neurotoxicity syndrome (ICANS), and 47% for dysgeusia.
  * Elastic net-based predictive models were developed using baseline clinical and laboratory variables to risk-stratify patients for severe immunotoxicities.

* **[Longitudinal multi-omics profiles differentiate persistent breast cancer treatment sequelae](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.29.26364331)** — *bioRxiv/medRxiv/PubMed*
  * A longitudinal cohort study of 16 breast cancer patients tracked clinical chemistries, proteomics, metabolomics, and gut microbiome profiles across 8 visits from pre-chemotherapy baseline through 2 years post-treatment.
  * Patients experiencing persistent fatigue at 2 years post-chemotherapy were distinguished by a secondary surge in fatigue scores starting around 12 months, accompanied by elevated plasma INHBB and depleted RAB37 levels.

* **[Rare KCND3 C-terminal variants implicated in Brugada Syndrome](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.30.26364181)** — *bioRxiv/medRxiv/PubMed*
  * Genome sequencing of 983 Brugada Syndrome (BrS) probands revealed a significant enrichment of rare, C-terminal-clustering variants in the *KCND3* gene compared to controls (p = 0.004).
  * Patch-clamp analyses of Kv4.3 currents in a heterozygous HEK293 cell model confirmed that these rare variants cause a gain-of-function (GoF) in the transient outward potassium current.

* **[Preclinical evaluation of rapamycin and canagliflozin in canine aging model](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.09.750505)** — *bioRxiv/medRxiv/PubMed*
  * A 90-day intervention study in 24 young laboratory Beagles evaluated the systemic cytokine and hematologic responses to rapamycin, canagliflozin, or dietary restriction.
  * Rapamycin was associated with the broadest endpoint cytokine response, contributing key baseline and intervention data on sex-stratified immune aging in a translational canine model.

* **[Stabilin-2 deficiency linked to elevated venous thromboembolism risk](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.10.04.26363616)** — *bioRxiv/medRxiv/PubMed*
  * Characterization of a homozygous *STAB2* splice-site variant in a pediatric patient with recurrent severe venous thromboembolism (VTE) confirmed complete loss of function in the stabilin-2 scavenger receptor.
  * The deficiency resulted in highly elevated circulating levels of its clearance ligands, including von Willebrand factor (VWF), coagulation factor VIII (FVIII), and hyaluronic acid, rendering the plasma highly procoagulant.

* **[Intestinal FXR agonism synergizes with leptin to reduce appetite](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42834123/)** — *bioRxiv/medRxiv/PubMed*
  * Preclinical work established that intestinal farnesoid X receptor (FXR) activation works cooperatively with leptin to mitigate obesity.
  * The synergistic effect is driven by a reduction in appetite mediated via secretin signaling pathways.

* **[Gcn5l1 governs metabolic heart-to-liver crosstalk in HFpEF](https://doi.org/10.1101/2025.02.05.636634)** — *bioRxiv/medRxiv/PubMed*
  * Researchers identified Gcn5l1 as a heart-specific factor essential for protecting against systemic metabolic dysfunction in cardiometabolic heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF).
  * Knockdown of Gcn5l1 disrupted heart-to-liver communication pathways, exacerbating systemic metabolic defects and liver disease progression in preclinical models.

* **[Smartphone-based motor composites optimize sample sizes for early Parkinson's trials](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.29.26363876)** — *bioRxiv/medRxiv/PubMed*
  * Using placebo-arm data from four large Phase II trials of early-stage Parkinson's disease (SPARK, PASADENA, PADOVA, and LUMA), investigators compared the sensitivity of MDS-UPDRS Part III assessments to smartphone-based motor functional composites (MFC).
  * Calculations based on relative responsiveness demonstrated that MFC endpoints significantly reduce the required sample sizes and treatment durations needed to detect therapeutic effects.

* **[MedGemma open vision-language models demonstrate multimodal clinical reasoning](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04626-w)** — *Nature Medicine*
  * Introduced MedGemma, a collection of open medical vision-language foundation models built on Gemma 3 across image, text, and multiple medical imaging domains.
  * Demonstrated advanced medical reasoning and understanding while exceeding the performance of similarly sized generative models and maintaining base model capabilities.

2. **Early Trials — Phase I–II**

* **[Biotech] [Psilocybin demonstrates clinical feasibility in open-label OCD trial](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.10.01.26364511)** — *bioRxiv/medRxiv/PubMed*
  * A waitlist-controlled, open-label randomized trial at Johns Hopkins University School of Medicine evaluated repeated psilocybin dosing (20 mg followed by 30 mg, two weeks apart) in 30 patients with treatment-resistant obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD).
  * The multi-dose intervention demonstrated favorable safety, feasibility, and preliminary efficacy in patients who had failed prior conventional pharmacotherapy or exposure and response prevention (ERP) therapy.

* **[Closed-loop fMRI neurofeedback targets negative attentional bias in depression](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.30.26363896)** — *bioRxiv/medRxiv/PubMed*
  * A randomized, sham-controlled trial (N = 48) evaluated a closed-loop functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) neurofeedback protocol designed to train patients with major depressive disorder (MDD) to ignore negative emotional stimuli.
  * Real-time decoding of internal attentional states adjusted stimulus opacity to externalize and correct real-time attentional lapses, demonstrating the feasibility of targeted neurofeedback to modulate pathological biases.

* **[LubriShield Foley catheter reduces biofilm formation in randomized trial](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.29.26364294)** — *bioRxiv/medRxiv/PubMed*
  * A prospective, single-blind randomized controlled trial (N = 33) compared the superhydrophilic, covalently bonded hydrogel-coated LubriShield Foley catheter against an uncoated silicone catheter.
  * The hydrogel coating met primary safety endpoints, demonstrated improved patient comfort, and successfully limited surface friction and microbial colonization without the use of active antimicrobial agents.

* **[Long-term follow-up of in vivo BCMA CAR-T cells shows variable durability in myeloma](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04704-z)** — *Nature Medicine*
  * Extended follow-up of four patients with relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma treated with in vivo BCMA CAR-T cells revealed a limited duration of response in three patients.
  * One patient achieved and sustained a clinical response out to 15 months.

* **[Biotech] [Kapa reports positive Phase 2 interim efficacy for ENV-105 in prostate cancer](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2107433772119376070)** — *BioStocks / X*
  * Announced positive, statistically significant interim efficacy data from an ongoing Phase 2 trial of ENV-105.
  * The trial is evaluating ENV-105 in patients with metastatic prostate cancer.

* **[Biotech] [Viking Therapeutics initiates Phase 1/2 oral maintenance trial of VK2735](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2107427529455714574)** — *BioStocks / X*
  * Initiated a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled study evaluating oral maintenance dosing of VK2735.
  * Enrolling approximately 195 otherwise healthy adult patients with obesity (BMI ≥30 kg/m²).

3. **Late & Pivotal Trials — Phase III**

* **[Baseline negative symptoms predict longer time to relapse in schizophrenia](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.28.26363883)** — *bioRxiv/medRxiv/PubMed*
  * A pooled analysis of patient-level data from 557 schizophrenia patients randomized to placebo across five double-blind, antipsychotic withdrawal relapse-prevention trials (≥6 months duration) investigated predictors of relapse.
  * Higher baseline negative symptoms (PANSS) predicted a significantly longer time to relapse, whereas higher positive symptoms predicted rapid relapse, demonstrating opposing predictive values of equal magnitude in the pooled model.

* **[ORIENTAL ENDOLOW trial protocol finalized for mechanical thrombectomy in minor stroke](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.10.03.26364630)** — *bioRxiv/medRxiv/PubMed*
  * The protocol for a multicenter randomized clinical trial (N = 264) has been established to evaluate whether endovascular therapy (EVT) combined with best medical therapy (BMT) achieves superior functional outcomes relative to BMT alone.
  * The study targets patients presenting with acute minor anterior circulation ischemic stroke (low baseline NIHSS scores) secondary to confirmed large vessel occlusion.

* **[Biotech] [ArriVent BioPharma Phase 3 FURVENT trial of firmonertinib misses primary endpoint](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2107441411062964560)** — *BioStocks / X*
  * The Phase 3 FURVENT study evaluating firmonertinib in first-line EGFR Exon 20 insertion mutant non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) failed to meet its primary endpoint.

4. **Regulatory & Approvals**

* **[Biotech] [Grail's multicancer early detection test faces efficacy criticism](https://www.statnews.com/2026/10/06/grail-multi-cancer-screening-test-criticism/)** — *STAT*
  * An expert opinion piece argued against FDA approval of Grail’s multicancer screening test, citing concerns that the test increases cancer diagnoses without proving a reduction in overall cancer mortality.

* **[Biotech] [FDA grants Priority Review to BridgeBio's NDA for oral infigratinib](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2107433517097382211)** — *BioStocks / X*
  * Accepted the New Drug Application (NDA) for oral infigratinib for the treatment of children with achondroplasia under Priority Review.
  * Set a target PDUFA action date of February 4, 2027.

* **[FDA requests public input on early-phase clinical trial designs for ibogaine](http://www.fda.gov/drugs/resources-drugs/psychedelic-drugs)** — *U.S. FDA*
  * Published a request for information (RFI) detailing trial design approaches under consideration for early-phase clinical evaluations of ibogaine drug products.
  * Public feedback and comments on the regulatory framework remain open through November 20, 2026.

* **[FDA CDER launches Quantitative Medicine Center of Excellence and adopts ICH M15](http://www.fda.gov/about-fda/center-drug-evaluation-and-research-cder/cder-quantitative-medicine-center-excellence-qm-coe)** — *U.S. FDA*
  * Established the CDER Quantitative Medicine Center of Excellence (QM CoE) to centralize strategic planning, education, and regulatory application of quantitative medicine across premarket and post-market reviews.
  * Issued ICH M15 guidance outlining principles for Model-Informed Drug Development (MIDD), covering evidence generation, evaluation frameworks, and submission standards.

* **[FDA advances rare disease trial tools and clinical protocol harmonization](http://www.fda.gov/about-fda/accelerating-rare-disease-cures-arc-program/rare-disease-news-events)** — *U.S. FDA*
  * Finalized ICH M11 guidance providing recommendations, structured templates, and technical specifications for harmonized digital clinical trial protocols.
  * Accepted a Letter of Intent under the ISTAND program for a wearable sensor-derived digital outcome measure quantifying foot drop severity in rare neurological diseases.

* **[FDA approves first generic difelikefalin injection](http://www.fda.gov/drugs/drug-and-biologic-approval-and-ind-activity-reports/first-generic-drug-approvals)** — *U.S. FDA*
  * Approved ANDA 220919, marking the first generic approval for difelikefalin injection in the United States.

5. **Business & Strategy**

* **[Big Pharma] [Shionogi expands rare disease pipeline with $2B acquisition of IntraBio](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/shionogi-pays-2b-to-acquire-a-rare-disease-startup/832103/)** — *BioPharma Dive*
  * Shionogi has agreed to acquire Texas-based biotech IntraBio for $2 billion in cash, turning the company into a wholly owned subsidiary of its U.S. division.
  * The transaction adds Aqneursa, a drug recently approved for two inherited neurodegenerative disorders, to Shionogi's commercial portfolio alongside its existing rare disease therapeutic, Radicava (for ALS).

* **[Big Pharma] [Roche licenses Parkinson's candidate AL050 from Alector](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/nobel-optogenetics-roche-alector-csl-alentis-jaypirca-bayer/832083/)** — *BioPharma Dive*
  * Roche’s Genentech division has licensed full global rights to Alector's experimental enzyme replacement therapy AL050.
  * AL050 is designed to target a specific enzyme deficiency known to drive neurodegeneration in Parkinson's disease and other brain disorders.

* **[Big Pharma] [GE HealthCare to acquire radiopharmaceutical manufacturer Sofie Biosciences for $945M](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/ge-healthcare-acquire-sofie-biosciences-radiopharmaceuticals/832182/)** — *BioPharma Dive*
  * GE HealthCare has agreed to acquire Sofie Biosciences for $945 million in cash, expanding its reach in the U.S. radiopharmaceutical industry.
  * The acquisition gives GE HealthCare a U.S. manufacturing and distribution footprint for F18-labeled PET products, which have a highly time-sensitive 110-minute half-life.

* **[Academic and nonprofit hospitals enter commercial longevity clinic market](https://www.statnews.com/2026/10/06/hospitals-longevity-clinics-healthy-aging-wellness-trend/)** — *STAT*
  * Major nonprofit academic medical centers are increasingly entering the wellness and longevity market, launching healthy-aging programs that offer personalized testing and lifestyle advice at prices ranging from $5,500 to $45,000 annually.

* **[Big Pharma] [AstraZeneca shelves targeted androgen receptor degrader AZD9750](https://x.com/JacobPlieth/status/2107411710353305808)** — *ApexOnco / X*
  * Discontinued clinical development of its androgen receptor (AR) degrader program AZD9750.
  * Follows prior pipeline pruning of clinical-stage targeted AR degraders across the industry, including Bristol Myers Squibb's discontinuation of dezandrodeg and gridegalutamide.

6. **Public Health & Policy**

* **[Real-world pulse oximeter study reveals race-based calibration shift](https://www.statnews.com/2026/10/06/pulse-oximeters-overestimate-and-underestimate-blood-oxygen-study/)** — *STAT*
  * A new hospital study found that pulse oximeter devices switched from systematically overestimating blood oxygen levels to underestimating them.
  * These clinical inaccuracies were consistently worse in patients of color, highlighting ongoing device equity challenges.

* **[HCV prevalence estimation across the US from 2017 to 2020](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.29.26364309)** — *bioRxiv/medRxiv/PubMed*
  * A Bayesian spatial integrated abundance model estimated a mean US hepatitis C virus (HCV) prevalence of 1.32% between 2017 and 2020.
  * The model integrated surveillance, Medicaid claims, and direct-acting antiviral treatment data to establish state-level baselines to support HCV elimination targets.

* **[Real-world prescribing patterns of GLP-1 receptor agonists in older adults](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.29.26364340)** — *bioRxiv/medRxiv/PubMed*
  * A retrospective cohort analysis of type 2 diabetes patients aged ≥65 years from 2018 to 2026 mapped the rapid expansion of GLP-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RAs) compared to SGLT2 and DPP-4 inhibitors.
  * The study utilized a natural language processing pipeline to characterize initiation patterns and clinical outcomes among patients with varying baseline cognitive vulnerabilities and frailty.

* **[H2N3 and RSV drove severe acute respiratory infections in Brazil's 2026 season](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.10.03.26364639)** — *bioRxiv/medRxiv/PubMed*
  * Epidemiological data from the first 35 weeks of 2026 revealed a quintupling of influenza A (primarily H2N3) cases in February and March, leading to a peak in mortality in April.
  * Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) and rhinovirus also drove significant pediatric and geriatric mortality, highlighting vaccine-preventable gaps in seasonal immunization strategies.

* **[Federal judges question HHS in Medicare Advantage audit lawsuit](https://www.statnews.com/2026/10/05/humana-medicare-advantage-radv-audits-lawsuit-hearing/)** — *STAT*
  * During a federal hearing over Medicare Advantage Risk Adjustment Data Validation (RADV) audits, judges pushed back against HHS legal arguments in a high-stakes lawsuit brought by Humana.

* **[Adolescent nicotine pouch use associated with gingival and mucosal side effects](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.29.26364219)** — *bioRxiv/medRxiv/PubMed*
  * A UK mixed-methods study involving a survey of 3,659 nicotine pouch users (predominantly male, aged 16-22) and clinical examinations found that 45% of users reported oral side effects.
  * The most prevalent clinical findings included gingival recession (60%), mucosal burning sensations (41%), and leukoplakia-like white patches (30%).

* **[Idaho faith-healing exemptions protect parental medical neglect](http://sciencebasedmedicine.org/idaho-allows-faith-based-medical-neglect-to-kill-children/)** — *Science-Based Medicine*
  * An investigative review of law enforcement and medical records in Idaho highlights preventable pediatric deaths linked to the "Followers of Christ" faith-healing sect.
  * Current Idaho state laws provide criminal immunity to parents who choose prayer over medical care, preventing intervention by social workers and law enforcement to protect surviving siblings.

* **[Global pain reference curves mapped across 6.1 million individuals](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04696-w)** — *Nature Medicine*
  * Constructed global age- and sex-specific reference curves for 11 pain sites utilizing data from 6.1 million people across 118 countries.
  * Highlighted significantly elevated late-life pain prevalence in regions with low Human Development Index (HDI) scores, establishing a benchmark for cohort studies.

* **[International network launched to evaluate generative AI in global health](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04706-x)** — *Nature Medicine*
  * Established MAGIC, an international collaborative network created to systematically evaluate and validate generative artificial intelligence tools across global health settings.

**Worth watching:** **GLP-1 receptor agonist (GLP-1RA) prescribing in vulnerable seniors.** Real-world data from 2018 to 2026 indicates a sharp rise in GLP-1RA initiations among adults aged ≥65. Tracking how prescribing decisions and tolerability profiles map to varying degrees of baseline cognitive impairment and frailty will be critical as these therapeutics continue to dominate the cardiometabolic market.
